PROP-57888860-inv-005.text: Each cell must be exactly BYTES_PER_CELL length; each proof must be BYTES_PER_PROOF length.
PROP-57888860-inv-005.assertion: forall verify_batch(cells, proofs): forall c in cells: len(c) == BYTES_PER_CELL AND forall p in proofs: len(p) == BYTES_PER_PROOF

locations.note: Calls deserialize_compressed_g1_points for proofs (validates BYTES_PER_PROOF=48) and deserialize_cells for cells (validates BYTES_PER_CELL=2048)
